 ED CARSON 
 Updated 11:01 PM ET 11/01/2026
 Dow Jones futures rose Sunday night, along with S&P 500 futures and especially Nasdaq futures. Apple and the latest jobs report are due this week, but midterm elections will take center stage for investors. The stock market started off last week fine, but ended poorly. The Nasdaq fell as Google-parent Alphabet (GOOGL), Amazon.com (AMZN), ServiceNow (NOW), Intel (INTC), Fortinet (FTNT)…
